{{RaceIcon|Gnome|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Gnome|Female}} [[Gnome]] |boss={{RaceIcon|Observer}} [[Mergothid]] |level=35-41 |minlevel=35 |players=5 |key=[[Key to Stormwrought Castle]] |bosses={{Stormwrought Ruins}} }} '''Stormwrought Ruins''' is an instance dungeon located in [[Balor]], within the ruins of [[Stormwrought Castle]]. An impregnable fortress, once [[Duke Balor]]'s home and seat of power, Stormwrought Castle lies derelict atop the wave crashed cliffs of Balor. Seized during the [[First War]], all its inhabitants were slaughtered viciously, and those less fortunate taken captive to be used in heinous rituals. Years later, this abandoned ruin has now been claimed again, by the orcish [[Stormreaver clan]] and their sinister overlords of the [[Shadow Council]]. The no longer pristine halls of the castle harbor a menagerie of horror and depravity, with lingering ghosts, hulking demons and murmuring cultists skulking along the pitchblack halls of this horrid place. ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== Due to its length, the dungeon is separated into two parts: '''Stormwrought Castle''', which comprises the first five bosses, and '''Stormwrought Descent''', which comprises the last seven bosses.
